prompt_md: In a village, 80% of the men and 40% of the women are married, each to someone of the other sex in the same village. What percent of the village's adults are married?
prompt_short: 80% of men and 40% of women are married to each other. Percent married?
hint_md: Married men and married women come in equal numbers. So who outnumbers whom?
explain_intuition_md: Averaging 80% and 40% assumes equal numbers of men and women. But every married man has a married wife, so 40% of the women equals 80% of the men: there are twice as many women.
